_comment: Revenue targets in rupees. Zoho holds no quota data, so targets live here. Edit each quarter. '_default' applies to any owner without an explicit entry; omit an owner to fall back to it. Company target is the number shown when no owner filter is applied. 2026-09 corrected to 6000000 from the real 'Revenue Target - This Month' widget on the native Zoho IST Dashboard (screenshotted 2026-09-29, showed Target: Rs 60,00,000) - the placeholder default is still a guess for months without direct evidence.
